As a warehouse worker for DHL Aviation, you are trained to perform following tasks: loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing shipments by trucks and plains throughout the world. DHL has an excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience: enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important.

 
• Your knowledge of English is very good (important for all work and safety related instructions on the job).

• You can work full-time, 38hours a week.
 
• You can work from Monday through Friday on a weekly base in the shifts 7PM-3AM and 8PM-4AM.

• DHL Aviation is located on the following address: Vliegveld 117, 1820 Steenokkerzeel.
 
• You are able to get to work on your behalf

• Working safely comes first for you.
 
• You can work in accordance with internal quality processes and procedures, as well as legal requirements.

What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

 
• You help produce precast concrete elements.
 
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
 
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
 
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
 
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.

 As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

 
• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
 
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
 
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
 
• You can work both independently and in a team.
 
• You work safely and in an orderly way.

Nice-to-haves

 
• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - Medior Business Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
• Position: Business Functional Analyst

• Domain: Business Analysis / IT & Application Projects

• Seniority: Medior (3-5 years of experience)

• Working environment: Collaboration with business stakeholders, IT teams, Project Managers and external partners.

• Location : Bruxelles

• English: Fluent.

• Fluent in French and/or Dutch

Business Functional Analyst

We are looking for an experienced Business Functional Analyst to join an established team and help translate business needs into effective technology solutions.

In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, Project Managers, IT teams, external partners and vendors to understand business challenges, clarify requirements and support the successful delivery of functional solutions.

You will play a key role throughout the project lifecycle, from initial analysis and requirements gathering to solution design, testing, implementation and post-go-live support.

You combine strong analytical and communication skills with a pragmatic mindset. Beyond documenting business requests, you seek to understand the underlying needs, challenge assumptions constructively and contribute to defining the right solutions.
Key responsibilities

• Business & functional analysis:

• Facilitate workshops, interviews and working sessions with business stakeholders to understand objectives, challenges and requirements.

• Analyse and document current and future business processes, business rules, data flows and system interactions.

• Challenge business requests where appropriate and translate needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria.

• Assess impacts, dependencies and risks, ensuring alignment between business objectives, technical feasibility and project scope.

• Functional design & documentation:

• Create process models, functional design documents, data mappings, mock-ups and prototypes where needed.

• Support solution design and collaborate closely with development, architecture, vendor and testing teams to define fit-for-purpose solutions.

• Maintain clear functional documentation and requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

• Bridge between business & IT:

• Act as a key point of contact for functional questions throughout design, development, testing and implementation.

• Work closely with Project Managers, Developers and Test Engineers, supporting scope clarification, impact assessments, dependencies and requirement-related risks.

• Ensure that decisions and requirements are clearly understood across business and IT teams, from initial analysis through deployment.

• Testing & validation:

• Prepare functional test scenarios and support regression testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), in collaboration with the Test Engineer.

• Support business users during UAT and validate that delivered solutions meet agreed business and functional requirements.

• Analyse defects and root causes with business and technical teams and contribute to appropriate corrective actions.

• Continuous improvement:

• Proactively identify process improvements, automation opportunities and system enhancements.

• Support change and rollout activities, including documentation, training materials and business readiness where required.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions and help shape the evolution of the application landscape.

Professional experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience

• 3-5 years of experience in a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst or similar analytical and process-oriented IT project role

• Proven experience in requirements analysis, functional design or software implementation

• Hands-on experience with business process modelling and functional documentation, including use cases, user stories and acceptance criteria

• Experience supporting end-to-end solution delivery

 

Technical & functional knowledge:

• Familiarity with tools and systems such as:

• 

• Azure DevOps

• Confluence

• ERP solutions

• Microsoft 365

• Comfortable working with data-related concepts, integrations and APIs

• Ability to understand business processes and translate them into clear functional requirements

• Experience supporting testing and validation activities

Personal profile

We are looking for someone who is:

• Analytical, structured and solution-oriented

• Self-motivated, curious and proactive

• Flexible and comfortable adapting to change

• Able to anticipate needs, ask the right questions and challenge assumptions constructively

• Capable of bringing structure to ambiguous situations

• Reliable and able to manage priorities effectively

• Comfortable moving between business discussions and detailed functional conversations with IT teams

• An effective communicator who can manage complex stakeholder interactions diplomatically and professionally

• Collaborative, with a strong team spirit and willingness to share knowledge

• Interested in continuous learning and professional development

jobs.occupation: Senior Program Manager – Railway Planning Systems
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Direct the end-to-end delivery of high-impact software programs within the transport domain.
• Orchestrate complex RFP processes and manage "buy and integrate" vendor relationships.
• Facilitate strategic roadmap development and alignment with organizational goals.
• Lead and mentor agile and scrum delivery teams to ensure operational excellence.
• Partner with C-level executives to provide program transparency and strategic insights.
• Standardize program execution using frameworks like PM², PMBOK, or SAFe.

Requirements

• 10+ years of experience in software delivery project management and 6+ years in program management.
• 5+ years of experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery teams.
• 2+ years of experience in the Railway Industry with a proven record in planning systems.
• You possess end-to-end experience in "buy and integrate" models and have executed multiple RFP cycles.
• You have a proven track record in strategic roadmap creation and C-level stakeholder management.
• You're proficient with project management frameworks such as PM², PMBOK, or SAFe.
• You possess professional proficiency in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Proficiency with Software Development Life Cycles (SDLC).

Responsibilities

• Map end-to-end financial flows from charging sessions to journal entries, including billing, payments, and roaming settlements.
• Translate complex tariffs, subscriptions, and promotions into functional specifications and accounting logic within the ERP.
• Produce detailed process documentation, interface contracts, and data mappings for system integrations between platforms.
• Define accounting treatments for VAT, accruals, and revenue recognition in close collaboration with finance stakeholders.
• Design automated reconciliation processes between external platforms, payment providers, and the general ledger.
• Manage the finance backlog by creating user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing delivery tasks.
• Lead functional testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure full auditability and system reliability.

Requirements

• You bring 3+ years of experience as a business or functional analyst within finance, billing, or ERP environments.
• You possess functional expertise in Odoo, specifically within the Accounting, Invoicing, and Subscriptions modules.
• You have a strong command of financial fundamentals, including AR/AP, VAT treatment, accruals, and month-end closing processes.
• You're experienced in designing controls for high-volume automated transaction flows and system reconciliations.
• You have experience with system integrations, data mapping, and defining interface contracts between platforms.
• You possess a bachelor's or master's degree in finance, economics, business engineering, or a related field.
• You're able to produce clear technical specifications and test cases that bridge the gap between business and IT.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented, capable of aligning stakeholders across finance, product, and technology departments.
• You are fluent in English with a good command of French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in usage-based billing environments such as e-mobility, energy, telecom, or payments.
• Familiarity with AMPECO or other charging point management systems (CPMS).

Responsibilities

• Lead the preparation, coordination, and monitoring of system and user acceptance testing for complex application projects.
• Coordinate a team of application experts, providing clear direction and guidance to ensure high-quality delivery.
• Integrate AI-assisted testing into the test lifecycle to improve efficiency in analysis, design, and execution.
• Collaborate with stakeholders, including project leads and business analysts, to align testing activities with business objectives.
• Monitor and report on test progress, defects, and risks while defining criteria for go/no-go decisions.
• Promote knowledge sharing and experiment with new AI tools to strengthen the overall testing capabilities of the organization.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience as a Test Manager, Test Coordinator, or in a similar quality assurance leadership role.
• Proven hands-on experience with AI-assisted testing and the ability to translate AI knowledge into practical test approaches.
• Advanced knowledge of testing methodologies, tools, and best practices.
• Possess an ISTQB Foundation certification or higher.
• Experience in stakeholder management and leading cross-functional teams in a structured environment.
• Strong analytical skills with a focus on problem-solving and meeting challenging deadlines.
• You are fluent in English with fluency in Dutch or French and a good level of the other.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid project methodologies.
• Knowledge of modern test automation frameworks and AI-driven quality tools.
• Understanding of life insurance applications and business processes.
• Proficiency in French, Dutch, and English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Network Security Engineer – F5 & AWAF
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Manage and maintain F5 infrastructure, specifically the Advanced Web Application Firewall modules.
• Install and configure F5 components including APM, ASM, and LTM for secure application delivery.
• Develop and document technical security policies and monitor their consistent application.
• Conduct technical risk analyses and implement remediation strategies to address system vulnerabilities.
• Monitor the security state of IT systems and provide rapid intervention during network intrusions or crisis situations.
• Advise on technical solutions for securing external partner connections via intranet and internet.
• Produce comprehensive technical documentation and incident reports for internal stakeholders.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in IT security with a focus on network protection and infrastructure management.
• Expertise in F5 infrastructure including F5 AWAF, APM, ASM, LTM, Identity Provider, and SSL VPN.
• Strong knowledge of network and application firewalls such as Palo Alto, Forcepoint, and Panorama.
• Advanced proficiency in network protocols and security standards including TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL, and SNMP.
• Experience using monitoring and log correlation tools such as Splunk, Nessus, or Elastic SIEM.
• Proven capability in performing technical risk analyses and vulnerability remediation.
• Demonstrated experience in security crisis management and incident response.
• Methodical and precise approach with a strong ability to document technical processes.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch with at least basic knowledge of the other, and technical English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of wireless network security including WPA2 and encryption principles.
• Experience with Citrix terminal-server solutions.

Responsibilities

• Configure and develop modules for financial flows including invoicing, accounting, and subscription management.
• Build and maintain integrations between management systems for data synchronization and automated invoice generation.
• Develop interfaces for payment service providers and bank statement imports to enable automated reconciliation.
• Design robust interfaces focusing on idempotent processing, replay mechanisms, and data integrity.
• Translate functional specifications into documented code while prioritizing standard platform capabilities.
• Participate in code reviews and support deployment pipelines across development and production environments.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in Odoo development with recent versions.
• 3+ years working with Python, the Odoo ORM, PostgreSQL, and XML views.
• Experience with Odoo accounting and invoicing modules, including journals, taxes, and multi-company setups.
• Technical experience with REST APIs, XML-RPC / JSON-RPC, webhooks, and ETL.
• Knowledge of software development lifecycle tools including Git, CI/CD, and containerized environments.
• Functional understanding of accounting principles and financial reconciliation.
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach to technical design.
• You are fluent in English with professional proficiency in French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with OWL and front-end customization.
• Previous experience in high-volume transactional or usage-based billing environments.
• Knowledge of e-mobility or energy sector financial processes.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

• A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
• An international and multilingual setting
• An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
• A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security

Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)
Access and security

• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)
Hardware and lifecycle

• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
• Tickets, escalation and coordination
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity
Assets

• Knowledge of Arabic
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
• IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)
Soft skills

• Customer focus and service mindset
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management
• Clear communication with non-technical users
• Hands-on, proactive attitude
